subject.title: fix: preserve Feishu post line breaks

question: Should maintainers require live Feishu/Lark proof on this mergeable branch before it can be the canonical fix, or switch to another sibling branch after it becomes safely mergeable?
rationale: The remaining blocker is proof sufficiency and canonical branch selection, not a narrow code repair ClawSweeper can safely make from this review.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for ordinary prose, fenced code or raw tables, and the near-limit fallback before merge.

options.title: Adopt the proof-positive sibling after conflict repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 only after it is refreshed from conflicts and maintainers accept its broader fanout behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded fallback now
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the near-limit cramped-format fallback, but the branch still needs real behavior proof for the normal case.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for ordinary prose, fenced code or raw tables, and the near-limit fallback before merge.
